🩺 MCC Choice Filling Assistant

Tell us where, what and how you want to study. Rank your choices — #1 is your top priority.

1. About you

Select every quota you are eligible for. Only seats in the quotas you choose are shown.

2. Preferred states

Click to add, then drag or use ▲▼ to rank. Includes Union Territories.

3. Preferred programs

Pick every course you'd accept (MD, MS, DNB, Diploma) from the MCC seat matrix and rank them.

4. What matters most?

Add the factors you care about and rank them — #1 matters most. Skip any that don't matter to you.

Your final ranked colleges

Colleges are listed best quality first within your chosen programs; your ranked states and priorities set the match score, which breaks ties. If you entered your NEET PG rank, only colleges where it falls within the 2025 MCC closing rank (your category or Open, all rounds) are shown. Closing ranks, stipends and fees come from the MCC NEET PG 2025 closing-rank file; seat counts come from the PG 2025 DNB and Deemed University seat matrices (19.11.2025). Closing ranks are last year's guide, not a guarantee. College quality is a college's position among colleges offering the same program, quota and seat category, from a model of the ranks of students admitted through MCC NEET PG 2023 counselling. It shows how sought-after a seat was, not how good the teaching is; it covers All-India quota entrants only for government colleges, and colleges that admitted no one in 2023 have no figure. Verify on mcc.nic.in.
